content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Construct a table of values for a linear equation
Plot points from a table of values on a coordinate grid
Recognise and plot horizontal and vertical lines
Understand the link between an equation and its graph
Linear graphs appear throughout science, engineering, and everyday life. When a taxi charges a fixed fee plus a rate per mile, the cost increases

with distance — and plotting this relationship produces a straight line. Understanding how to plot linear graphs from their equations is a fundamental skill that underpins all graphical work in mathematics.
Explore linear graphs — plot straight-line graphs and explore gradient and y-intercept using the interactive visualisation below.
